name: airbnb-api (HalmonLui)
what_it_holds: MIT Flask/BeautifulSoup/Selenium unofficial API wrapper (15 stars, updated Mar 2026) that exposes Airbnb search-results-page data as a local REST API -- i.e. it re-serves scraped listing/price/availability fields through your own endpoint rather than a library call.
why_useful: Different architecture (self-hosted REST proxy) than the direct-library wrappers; useful reference if the team ever wants a service layer instead of a script, but same underlying fields as pyairbnb.
duplicate_of_holding: duplicates pyairbnb-class field coverage via a different interface
themes: Airbnb API wrappers and search-page clients (catalogue only, never run): pyairbnb, airbnb-scraper, airbnb search results parsers; note what fields they expose
why_all: Different architecture (self-hosted REST proxy) than the direct-library wrappers; useful reference if the team ever wants a service layer instead of a script, but same underlying fields as pyairbnb.

name: tsairbnb
what_it_holds: MIT TypeScript reimplementation of pyairbnb (updated Jul 2026, brand-new) with TLS impersonation, parser fallbacks, and serverless deployment -- built for resilience against Airbnb's anti-bot measures. Same field surface as pyairbnb (JSON HTTP wrapper).
why_useful: Most recently updated client in the sweep; documents the current anti-scraping countermeasures (TLS impersonation needed), which is itself useful context for why 2026 search-page scraping is getting harder / more ToS-fraught.
duplicate_of_holding: duplicates pyairbnb field coverage in TypeScript
themes: Airbnb API wrappers and search-page clients (catalogue only, never run): pyairbnb, airbnb-scraper, airbnb search results parsers; note what fields they expose
why_all: Most recently updated client in the sweep; documents the current anti-scraping countermeasures (TLS impersonation needed), which is itself useful context for why 2026 search-page scraping is getting harder / more ToS-fraught.

name: airbnb-scraper (petrpatek, Apify public actor)
what_it_holds: Public Apify actor source (11 stars) for scraping Airbnb homes; older (last updated Apr 2024) but was one of the original open Apify Airbnb actors many forks derive from (including dtrungtin's and trivikrama-madhusudhana's above).
why_useful: Lineage/reference only -- superseded by newer forks; kept for provenance.
duplicate_of_holding: ancestor of dtrungtin/actor-airbnb-scraper and other Apify forks listed here

why_all: Lineage/reference only -- superseded by newer forks; kept for provenance.

Second independent Apify-based Airbnb actor; low marginal value once dtrungtin/actor-airbnb-scraper and omkarcloud/airbnb-scraper are catalogued, but confirms the field set (price, availability, reviews, host) is consistent across independent implementations.

name: airbnb-scraper (toniprada) — user profiles
what_it_holds: Small, old repo (8 stars, updated Jan 2017) that downloads Airbnb user/host profile pages rather than listings.
why_useful: Niche and stale (2017); host-profile scraping could theoretically feed a host-growth/supply proxy but the tool itself is unmaintained and pre-dates Airbnb's current API/anti-bot posture. Catalogued for completeness only.
